paragraphs.text: He flees to God to be the judge of his just cause, seeing there is no equity among men.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: My very affections and inward motions of the heart.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: He shows what stayed him, that he did not recompense evil for evil.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: He declares that they cannot walk in simplicity before God, that delight in the company of the ungodly.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: I will serve you with a pure affection, and with the godly that sacrifice to you.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: Destroy me not in the overthrow of the wicked.
paragraphs.label: f
paragraphs.anchor: Gather not my soul with sinners

paragraphs.text: Whose cruel hands execute the malicious devises of their hearts.
paragraphs.label: g

paragraphs.text: I am preserved from my enemies by the power of God, and therefore will praise him openly.
paragraphs.label: h
